module.name: Ubuntu Kind Cluster
module.description: Bootstraps a remote Ubuntu host over SSH, installs Docker/kind/kubectl when needed, and creates a kind Kubernetes cluster for development/testing

required.name: ssh_host
required.description: SSH host or IP for the remote Ubuntu machine to bootstrap

required.name: ssh_private_key_path
required.description: Path on the runner to the SSH private key used for remote bootstrap

optional.name: cluster_name
optional.description: Name of the kind cluster created on the remote Ubuntu host

optional.name: kubernetes_version
optional.description: Kubernetes version for the remote kind node image

optional.name: worker_nodes
optional.description: Number of kind worker nodes to create on the remote host

optional.name: ssh_user
optional.description: SSH user on the remote Ubuntu machine

optional.name: ssh_timeout
optional.description: SSH connection timeout for remote bootstrap operations

optional.name: kind_version
optional.description: kind release to install on the remote host when kind is absent

optional.name: kubectl_version
optional.description: kubectl release to install on the remote host when kubectl is absent

key_outputs.name: kubeconfig_path
key_outputs.description: Local runner path to the kubeconfig copied back from the remote host

key_outputs.name: cluster_name
key_outputs.description: Name of the created kind cluster

key_outputs.name: cluster_endpoint
key_outputs.description: Cluster API endpoint as recorded in the copied kubeconfig

key_outputs.name: remote_kubeconfig_path
key_outputs.description: Remote host path of the generated kubeconfig file

key_outputs.name: remote_host
key_outputs.description: Remote Ubuntu host where the kind cluster was created
